newsitem.title: CHINA: Asian Metals-China, Glencore meet in zinc dispute.
newsitem.headline: Asian Metals-China, Glencore meet in zinc dispute.

text.p: China's metals industry authorities have protested to Swiss trading company Glencore in an ongoing dispute centering around the quality of Chinese zinc, a Chinese official said on Monday.

An official of the China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corp (CNNC) said a protest had been lodged with Glencore because of complaints the Swiss trader made about the quality of Chinese zinc ingots, which had damaged China's interests and reputation.
Glencore officials would meet with corporation officials in Beijing this week, he said by telephone.
Other industry sources said the meetings began on Monday.
Glencore officials in China declined to comment on Monday evening.
Glencore was a major client for zinc produced at the Huludao, Zhuzhou and Shaoguan smelters, all CNNC subsidiaries, he said.
"We are not afraid of their checks. In fact our zinc overall has passed their quality checks, but some of the zinc has not passed," he said.
"It is impossible to have 100 percent of our product up to standard," he said.
"They should have passed on the results to us. They should have returned the zinc to us so we could deliver good quality zinc to them," he said.

All three smelters produce zinc brands that are registered on the London Metal Exchange (LME), an indication that it conforms with international standards of quality, packaging and delivery reliability.
An official of China's Zhuzhou smelter said last week that Glencore had complained to the LME about the quality of 100 tonnes of the factory's zinc.
The dispute comes amid rumours on the market that Zhuzhou was heavily short, having sold options at around $1,250 a tonne. The Zhuzhou official denied this.
Zinc recently moved upto $1,495 on the LME, a 6-3/4 year high, before falling back slightly.
Traders have said that because Zhuzhou had been using old, lower grade ingots to re-process into its special high grade (SHG) deliverable Torch brand ingots, quality could be affected.
